name: Dual native Rust TCP
summary: Pinned pktkit TCP with paired original Linux Normal native owner integration; scoped real-product dual-ISA function PASS.

usage.cli: Experimental: both Linux endpoints --dual-rust-tcp --mode normal, client --auto-ip, server --lease-pool; mutually exclusive with old --tcp-proxy-cc.
usage.config: Cold paired selection only; no private TLS exchange or auto-detection; old path remains default for comparison.

verification.scope: Initial pinned TCP core (327 native unit tests)
Native component: inner TCP endpoints, actual kernel origin socket bidirectional bytes, origin-to-virtual-app FIN (not product TUN)
Paired Normal actual product TCP bidirectional bytes, half-close, concurrency, UDP, owned Stop
Experimental CUBIC middle SOURCE with original kernel BBR functional fixture, actual Normal business and Stop
Other affected modes, multiple leases and generation handoff
